lines.t: Good morning, this is Anita calling from Suraksha Life Insurance. Am I speaking with Mr Reddy?
Yes, speaking. Who is this again?
Anita from Suraksha Life. You had asked for a call back about our plans on our website.
Oh yes, I did. Go ahead.
Before we discuss anything, may I confirm your date of birth for verification?
It is the fourteenth of August, nineteen eighty six.
Thank you, that matches our records.
Can I ask what you are mainly saving for, and who depends on your income?
Mostly my daughter's education. She is six. My wife and my mother depend on me too.
And do you already have any life cover?
Only a small group policy through my office.
For your family, a term plan gives the most cover for the money. Our Term Shield gives one crore of cover.
And the cost?
The premium is fourteen thousand two hundred rupees a year. It is pure protection, so nothing is paid back at maturity.
Suicide within the first year is excluded, and the cover ends at age sixty five.
Fine, that is clear.
Would you like me to go ahead and generate the proposal in your name?
Yes, please go ahead.
Once you receive the policy document you have a thirty day free look period. If you change your mind in that time, you can cancel and get your premium back after small deductions.
Good to know.
Thank you for your time. You will receive the documents by email today.
Thank you, bye.
